title: Jiangbin AI
text:
An independent technical space for AI tools, engineering methods, and privacy-reviewed public notes.
This website does not publish employment history, employers, education, client information, contact details, photographs, QR codes, or non-public projects and production architecture. Public materials focus on general methods that are understandable, reviewable, and safe to discuss.

General design trade-offs in task decomposition, agent workflows, knowledge systems, and developer experience.
